summary: Added tools/package-share-build.py, which wraps the existing bash tools/export.sh windows output into one shareable ZIP (game + a plain Play L5R Emperor.cmd launcher + READ ME) that a non-technical friend can extract and double-click, with no dev tools, source checkout, or GitHub account required. Follow-up to #547 (Windows dev launcher).
validation: Installed Godot export templates (python3 tools/bootstrap.py --install --with-templates), ran bash tools/export.sh windows end to end (dotnet build, Godot headless import, Godot export-release, its own Python validation of managed libraries/.NET host/resources/source-omission) -- succeeded, produced artifacts/windows/L5R-Emperor-Windows.zip. Ran python3 tools/package-share-build.py, producing artifacts/share/L5R-Emperor-Play-Windows.zip (~2.1GB). Extracted that ZIP to a clean temp folder and launched Play L5R Emperor.cmd via os.startfile (the same ShellExecute path Explorer uses for a double-click); confirmed the launched L5R-Emperor.exe process stayed alive, responding, and actively consuming CPU/memory for 40+ seconds (CPU climbed 14.7s to 25s) with no crash. Iterated once: added --log-file to the launcher so its own game.log is unambiguous (the shared default Godot user-data log path was found to mix output with another concurrent session's own UI checks on this machine) -- repackaged and retested with the same healthy-process result. Cleaned up all test processes/temp files. python3 -c ast.parse syntax-checked the script. Did not commit the ~2.1GB output ZIP (artifacts/ is gitignored, matches AGENTS.md guidance to keep game binaries out of git).
remaining: None for the packaging script itself; ready for review. The actual shareable ZIP (artifacts/share/L5R-Emperor-Play-Windows.zip) is a local build artifact, not part of this PR -- Mendon regenerates it locally (bash tools/export.sh windows && python3 tools/package-share-build.py) whenever he wants an updated build to send friends. This worktree's fresh Godot import also regenerated resource uid:// values in many committed .import files as pure cache churn (confirmed via diff -- only the uid changed, no real content); left uncommitted/unstaged in this worktree, not part of this change.
